ShortDescription.Value: Put your districts into groups, then assign a whole group to a service building at once.

Publish.LongDescription:
In the base game you pick which districts a service building serves. You do this for every building, one at a time. If you paint a new district or change your mind, you have to edit every building again.
District Groups makes this easier.
**This mod is in alpha.** The core functionality is complete, I am just figuring out the best UI.
**How to use it**
1. Open the District Groups panel. 2. Make a group. Give it a name and pick a service type, like fire or garbage. 3. Add districts to the group. 4. Select a service building. In its info panel, pick a group.
The building now serves every district in that group. Later, when you add or remove a district, every building that uses the group updates by itself.
**Good to know**
- One district can be in many groups. - A building only sees groups that match its own service type. - This mod does not change how the game works. It only fills in the "districts served" list for you. - While a building uses a group, the mod controls its district list. If you edit that list by hand, your change will be replaced.
**If you remove the mod**
Your buildings keep serving their districts. Only the groups are lost. Loading a save without the mod is safe. But if you save the game while the mod is removed, the groups are gone for good.
